title: Unboxing Motorola’s New $300 Moto G Power (2026)

title: Dolby Vision 2 and Dolby Vision 2 Max Is Coming: What to Know

author: CNET
description:
Stay on target! 🎯🌌 Target Darts is showcasing its collaboration with both Star Wars and Xbox. 

The basic Star Wars set comes with a branded board and wall protector that resembles the cockpit of the Millennium Falcon and costs $200. The board is of very high quality, with a tight-knit sisal fiber face, and the protector is thick enough to keep stray shots out of your drywall.

The big tech twist to this board, though, is the Omni light ring around the outside. It uses four cameras to track your dart’s position, then sends that info to an app that keeps score. Here’s what you need to know #tech #dartboard #darts #ces2026 #starwars
title: Stay On Target! 🎯 The Dartboard For a Star Wars Fan

author: CNET
description:
WALL-E?!?! Feed this trash can-like device plastic bags, and when it’s full, it heats the plastic and presses it into a brick. Then use a premade envelope to ship it to a processing facility. 

The SPC isn’t cheap, retailing for about $1,400. But customers don’t need to pay the entire amount up-front — they can pay $200 initially and then $50 per month for 24 months thereafter, which includes the shipping and recycling services. 

The Soft Plastic Composter was named the winner of the Best Sustainability category in the Best of CES 2026 Awards. #cleardrop #sustainability #ces2026 #compactor #plasticpollution
title: Clear Drop’s $1,400 Soft Plastic Compactor Turns Plastic Bags Into Recyclable Bricks ♻️
